# Emad Alhamou

> Personal site of Emad Alhamou, a Syrian-German founder and product builder based in Germany. He builds TakeCar, Shfli, and Arab Solutions: products for mobility, marketplaces, and AI-powered customer support in emerging markets. The site is in Arabic, English and German (picked from the browser language, switchable in the footer).

## Main page

- [hamou.de](https://hamou.de/): About Emad, his companies, open-source tools, experience, and contact.

## Products

- [TakeCar](https://takecarapp.com): Syrian mobility platform.
- [Arab Solutions](https://omysyria.com/ar): AI customer support platform that brings knowledge and channels into one place.
- [Shfli](https://www.shfli.com/?section=items): Platform for buying, selling, and auctions.
- [Nadhif](https://nadhif.hamou.de/): Mac cleaner and security checker for Macs, servers and websites, built for Alhamou (in development since September 2026).

## Open source

- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/Alhamou): OpenBlock, RemoteDesk, pinFiy, closeAll, SafeShare, TopMovies, moveMouse, Haki.
